title: Horizon batcher: adaptive heuristics and safe continuous apply
creator: Asha Raman
description: Build an adaptive batching recommender (Horizon batcher) that synthesizes workload profiles and lightweight heuristics to produce continuous batching parameter updates with safe, auditable applies and automated rollback triggers. This ticket covers the profiling pipeline extension, the heuristic policy engine, the controlled apply path (shadow -> canary -> gradual roll), and the safety runbook for rollback conditions. Goal is to reduce per-token serving cost by recommending batching configs that respect latency SLOs and KV-cache semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Profiling pipeline produces stable workload signatures for 95% of sampled routes within 24h
Heuristic engine outputs a recommended batch config manifest for a route with estimated cost delta and risk score
Safe apply flow (shadow -> canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%) can be executed via the console and reverted automatically when rollback conditions hit
No observable P50 latency regression > 10% for canary routes and P99 increase limited to < 25ms during gradual apply
Telemetry and trace links for each apply are surfaced in the rollout UI and persisted for 30 days
success_metrics: Average token cost reduction across pilot routes >= 8%
False-positive rollback rate < 2% (automatic rollbacks triggered incorrectly)
Operator time required to approve/revert per rollout < 5 minutes
updates: 2025-02-18 - Asha Raman: Kickoff and scoping. Drafted approach: extend workload sampler to collect per-route seq-length distribution, KV-cache hit rate, short-tail vs long-tail request ratio. Identified initial risk signals: P99 latency, token generation timeout, and increase in model-variant fallbacks.

2025-02-21 - Marcus Liu: Prototype profiling job landed (refs: GH PR #4827). It runs extended sampling in shadow mode and emits ‘route-signature-v1’ tags. Found noisy routes (frequent parameterized prompts) — will add normalization step to group by prompt fingerprint.

2025-02-26 - PM review (Lena Ortiz): Confirmed success metrics and asked for explicit customer impact categories (noisy, latency-sensitive, cost-opportunistic). Added to labels. Suggested adding a conservatism knob for enterprise customers.
2025-02-28 - Design feedback (Noah Perez): UX for rollout needs a compact risk summary: risk score, expected cost delta, top contributing signals. Will add mockups to the Confluence doc.

2025-03-03 - Marcus Liu: Implemented heuristic engine v0 with rules: max_batch_size = min(hardware_limit, floor(1.25 * median_tokens)), prefer batching when KV-hit-rate >= 0.3 and short_tail_ratio >= 0.6. Added a safety multiplier that reduces batch size for latency-sensitive routes. Unit tests added. PR #4892 opened.

2025-03-04 - Ops simulation: Ran shadow apply across staging cluster for 48h. Observed median cost reduction 9.6% on sampled dataset. Detected three routes with P99 spikes during microburst windows; created follow-up ENG-472901 to add microburst detection and throttle-aware heuristics.

2025-03-05 - Asha Raman: Drafted safety runbook and rollback conditions: automatic rollback triggers when canary P99 > baseline P99 * 1.25 OR error-rate delta > 0.5%, or model fallback rate increases > 2x. Added requirement for human review when estimated customer impact is high.
Blockers: need console rollout UI support for staged percentage targets (ENG-521337). Also awaiting infra quota for extended shadow runs in eu-west-1 (ticket INF-193).
